notes:
- Realistic weapons (Poly Haven, CC0): the Longshot is now a real bolt-action rifle, and the Slugger
  Bat, Katana, Fire Axe and Combat Knife are real models too. Camos still work on them.
- Slim sniper scope: a 25 mm tube with tapered ends, thin rings and small turrets, replacing the chunky
  voxel scope (same aim point).
- Thin iron sights again, like the early versions: a slim front post and a notched rear sight with
  small glowing dots, on every gun that uses irons.
- Better hands: thicker, shorter forearms with fabric folds that come in from the corners of the screen
  (they were long thin sticks). Melee weapons are held in a proper voxel fist with a sleeve instead of
  plain boxes.
- Camo challenges: gun camos are now earned with headshot kills using that gun (10 for Woodland up to
  750 for Dark Matter). The LOADOUT screen shows your progress, and a banner pops up when you unlock one.
  Camos you already earned stay unlocked. Melee camos still unlock with weapon level.
